high_level_description: The image depicts a musician performing on stage. The focus is on the musician's hands and forearms, which are heavily tattooed with various designs. The person is wearing a white t-shirt featuring a graphic design that includes the text "FIT TO FIGHT, FIT TO WIN" and an illustration of a soldier in military attire. The shirt also has the word "BRAVO" vertically written down one side. The musician is playing a green electric guitar, which is partially visible behind their hands. In front of them, there is a pedalboard with several guitar pedals connected by cables.
